notes.title: Take a ride - Update
notes.content:
Hi! This is "Take a ride". Big update for Bloody trains
We finally reached 30 copies goal!!!
And can release a new Line.

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
 [*] New line! - "D LINE"
   [list]
   [*]New boss at the end of the line
   [*]3 new long levels
   [/list]
[*]Toilet lock mechanic now starts from 11 station
[*]Roguelike bosses and map - hugly reworked. Now you can choose next level on roguelike map.
[*]Vulnerable spots in Bosses changed. Now they fade only after getting damage
[*]Length of first 5 levels reduced by 1 minute each
[*]Length of 6-9 levels reduced to 6 minute each
[*]Length of 11-14 levels reduced to 7 minute each
[*]No GAME OVER if you have -250 money of less
[*]Saves changed. Now you can start level from the time you exit.
[/list]

[b]Visuals:[/b]
[list]
[*]Levels color scheme changes after 10 station
[*]Small changes in showing transfer station on story map
[*]Passengers now have masks on later levels
[*]New tags in start menu stage
[*]Small changes in tutorial parts
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Progression after 10 station fixed
[*]Gamepad Push on Bosses fixed 
[*]Gamepad Buttons fix
[/list]

Hope you'll like new content.
Please leave a comment and tell your friends!

notes.title: Update goal 30/30
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! 
I want to announce new update goal.
In this future update I will add new level with huge train cars and a new boss.

But to properly publish this update I need at least [b]30 copies[/b]. 

Bloody trains sale [b]20 copies[/b] for now, so if you want to support the game it's time!

Thanks!
